# Electron bridge (generated)

What the page can call. The page sees these objects on `window`. Read [electron-bridge.md](../electron-bridge.md) for the rules.

| Object | Function | Channel |
|---|---|---|
| `native` | `platform` | none (a value) |
| `native` | `versions` | none (a value) |
| `themeAPI` | `getSystemTheme` | invoke `get-system-theme` |
| `themeAPI` | `onThemeChange` | event `system-theme-changed` |
| `portalAPI` | `clearSession` | invoke `clear-portal-session` |
| `dbAPI` | `isReady` | invoke `is-db-ready` |
| `dbAPI` | `onReady` | event `db-ready` |
| `updaterAPI` | `onStatus` | event `updater-status` |
| `updaterAPI` | `check` | invoke `updater-check` |
| `updaterAPI` | `download` | invoke `updater-download` |
| `updaterAPI` | `install` | invoke `updater-install` |
| `shutdownAPI` | `onShuttingDown` | event `app-shutting-down` |
| `shutdownAPI` | `onProgress` | event `shutdown-progress` |
